SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret for sessions and CSRF. Auto-generated at deploy; rotate only if compromised.

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Fernet key for encrypting sensitive values in the database. Auto-generated at deploy.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: One-time token for /setup/<token>/ to create the first admin. Copy from variables after deploy.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key with send and receive access. Create at https://resend.com/api-keys

MAIL_DOMAIN.description: Domain verified in Resend for sending and receiving (e.g. mail.example.com).

ADMIN_RECOVERY_EMAIL.description: Inbox that receives admin password-reset emails (any address you control).

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public base URL of this deployment. Defaults to your Railway domain; set if using a custom domain.

DATA_ROOT.description: Path for SQLite and mail blobs. Must match the volume mount (/data).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period (seconds) for Gunicorn and the worker to shut down cleanly during deploys.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional Web Push VAPID public key (base64url). Generate with py-vapid; pair with VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional Web Push VAPID private key (PEM or DER base64url from `vapid --gen`). Must be a matched pair with VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY; do not use a random secret.

PUSH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS.description: Seconds to debounce new-mail push notifications per mailbox (default 45).
